svg.title: Save a repeatable task as a skill
svg.desc: A skill file contains directions a helper can reuse with fresh input. Test the directions on more than one case. Write the recipe. Describe what to read, what to do and what to return. First run. Supply one practice input and check the result. Second run. Change the input. Check that the answer follows the new data.
svg.text: Save a repeatable task as a skill
A skill file contains directions a helper can reuse with fresh input. Test
the directions on more than one case.
Describe what to read, what to do and what to return.
Supply one practice input and check the result.
Change the input. Check that the answer follows the new data.
